title: Canadian Rice Bake
description: A nutritious and flavorful rice bake with grassy notes, perfect as a hearty meal.
instructions: In a large pot, bring the vegetable broth to a boil. Add the wild rice and quinoa, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a separate pan, sauté the mushrooms, onion, and garlic until the vegetables are tender.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rice mixture, sautéed vegetables, and cheddar cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish, drizzle with melted butter, and top with additional shredded cheese if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
